title: Minimum Absolute Difference in BST
statement: Find the minimum absolute difference between values of any two nodes in a BST.

title: Minimum Absolute Difference in BST
statement: Find the minimum absolute difference between values of any two nodes in a BST.
code: class Solution { Integer prev=null;int best=Integer.MAX_VALUE;public int getMinimumDifference(TreeNode root){prev=null;best=Integer.MAX_VALUE;dfs(root);return best;}void dfs(TreeNode n){if(n==null)return;dfs(n.left);if(prev!=null)best=Math.min(best,n.val-prev);prev=n.val;dfs(n.right);} }

title: K-diff Pairs in an Array
statement: Count unique pairs with absolute difference k.

title: K-diff Pairs in an Array
statement: Count unique pairs with absolute difference k.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int findPairs(int[] nums,int k){if(k<0)return 0;Map<Integer,Integer> c=new HashMap<>();for(int x:nums)c.put(x,c.getOrDefault(x,0)+1);int ans=0;if(k==0){for(int v:c.values())if(v>1)ans++;}else for(int x:c.keySet())if(c.containsKey(x+k))ans++;return ans;} }

title: Encode and Decode TinyURL
statement: Design encode and decode methods that map long URLs to short URLs and back.
code:
import java.util.*;
public class Codec { private Map<String,String> toKey=new HashMap<>(),toUrl=new HashMap<>();private int next=1;public String encode(String longUrl){if(!toKey.containsKey(longUrl)){String k=Integer.toString(next++);toKey.put(longUrl,k);toUrl.put(k,longUrl);}return "http://tinyurl.com/"+toKey.get(longUrl);}public String decode(String shortUrl){return toUrl.get(shortUrl.substring(shortUrl.lastIndexOf('/')+1));} }

title: Complex Number Multiplication
statement: Multiply two complex numbers represented as strings in the form a+bi.
code: class Solution { public String complexNumberMultiply(String num1,String num2){int[] a=parse(num1),b=parse(num2);return (a[0]*b[0]-a[1]*b[1])+"+"+(a[0]*b[1]+a[1]*b[0])+"i";}private int[] parse(String s){String[] p=s.substring(0,s.length()-1).split("\\+");return new int[]{Integer.parseInt(p[0]),Integer.parseInt(p[1])};} }

title: Convert BST to Greater Tree
statement: Transform each BST node so its value becomes its original value plus all original values greater than it.

title: Convert BST to Greater Tree
statement: Transform each BST node so its value becomes its original value plus all original values greater than it.
code: class Solution { private int sum=0;public TreeNode convertBST(TreeNode root){sum=0;dfs(root);return root;}private void dfs(TreeNode n){if(n==null)return;dfs(n.right);sum+=n.val;n.val=sum;dfs(n.left);} }

title: Minimum Time Difference
statement: Find the minimum difference in minutes between any two time points in a list.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int findMinDifference(List<String> timePoints){if(timePoints.size()>1440)return 0;int[] a=new int[timePoints.size()];for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++){String t=timePoints.get(i);a[i]=Integer.parseInt(t.substring(0,2))*60+Integer.parseInt(t.substring(3));}Arrays.sort(a);int best=1440+a[0]-a[a.length-1];for(int i=1;i<a.length;i++)best=Math.min(best,a[i]-a[i-1]);return best;} }

title: Single Element in a Sorted Array
statement: Find the single element in a sorted array where every other element appears exactly twice, in O(log n) time and O(1) space.

title: Single Element in a Sorted Array
statement: Find the single element in a sorted array where every other element appears exactly twice, in O(log n) time and O(1) space.
code: class Solution { public int singleNonDuplicate(int[] nums){int lo=0,hi=nums.length-1;while(lo<hi){int mid=(lo+hi)/2;if((mid&1)==1)mid--;if(nums[mid]==nums[mid+1])lo=mid+2;else hi=mid;}return nums[lo];} }

title: Reverse String II
statement: For every 2k characters, reverse the first k characters; reverse the remaining characters if fewer than k remain.

title: Reverse String II
statement: For every 2k characters, reverse the first k characters; reverse the remaining characters if fewer than k remain.
code: class Solution { public String reverseStr(String s,int k){char[] a=s.toCharArray();for(int i=0;i<a.length;i+=2*k){int l=i,r=Math.min(i+k-1,a.length-1);while(l<r){char t=a[l];a[l++]=a[r];a[r--]=t;}}return new String(a);} }

title: 01 Matrix
statement: For each cell in a binary matrix, return its distance to the nearest zero.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int[][] updateMatrix(int[][] mat){int m=mat.length,n=mat[0].length;int[][]d=new int[m][n];for(int[] row:d)Arrays.fill(row,-1);Queue<int[]>q=new ArrayDeque<>();for(int r=0;r<m;r++)for(int c=0;c<n;c++)if(mat[r][c]==0){d[r][c]=0;q.add(new int[]{r,c});}int[][]dirs={{1,0},{-1,0},{0,1},{0,-1}};while(!q.isEmpty()){int[]p=q.remove();for(int[]v:dirs){int r=p[0]+v[0],c=p[1]+v[1];if(r>=0&&r<m&&c>=0&&c<n&&d[r][c]<0){d[r][c]=d[p[0]][p[1]]+1;q.add(new int[]{r,c});}}}return d;} }

title: Diameter of Binary Tree
statement: Return the length of the longest path between any two nodes in a binary tree, measured in edges.

title: Diameter of Binary Tree
statement: Return the length of the longest path between any two nodes in a binary tree, measured in edges.
code: class Solution { private int best;public int diameterOfBinaryTree(TreeNode root){best=0;height(root);return best;}private int height(TreeNode n){if(n==null)return 0;int l=height(n.left),r=height(n.right);best=Math.max(best,l+r);return 1+Math.max(l,r);} }
